messages:
maria: Heads-up — after enabling prefill+speculative on the new 14b-quant build we observed a small but consistent quality regression: ~0.45% of responses repeat an earlier context fragment (stale prefix) instead of continuing. cc @rian :thinking_face:

rian: can you drop a minimal repro and the request id? which fallback/variant chain did you test (fp16 -> q4_0 / q4_1)?

maria: repro below (redacted). request_id=req-2026-03-21-8a7c

```
PROMPT:
User: Summarize the deployment convo about timing.
Context snippet ended with "we'll ship Wed"
Model output (bad): "... we'll ship Wed ... we'll ship Wed ..." then unrelated continuation

LOG (trim): prefetch:start req=req-2026-03-21-8a7c model=redwood-14b-quant prefetch_variant=q4_0 fallback_path=fp16->q4_0 kv_hit=1 kv_version=42
kv_apply: prefix_id=abc123 last_used=2026-03-20T23:12:02Z
serve: response returned 200 latency=84ms
```

devon: log suggests cached prefix applied across variant change. two suspects: (1) cache key missing model_variant -> collision, or (2) async prefetch applied stale offsets (race).

jess_qa: I reproduced locally with prefill enabled. ran 10k prompts randomized sessions; saw ~0.4% prefix-repeat cases vs baseline.

maria: @devon how are prefix_ids generated? we should include model_variant and seq_offset, but code might only hash prompt+user_id.

devon: checked prefetch/keygen.cc: key = sha256(prompt || user_id) — indeed missing model_variant and seq_offset. quick patch: include model_variant and seq_offset in key composition. will add feature flag `prefetch_strict_keys`.

rian: fine by me. tradeoff: stricter keys -> more misses after rollouts (expected) and potential cache size increase. acceptable for correctness.

maria: proposed rollout plan:
- patch keygen to include `model_variant` + `quant_tag`, gated by `prefetch_strict_keys` flag
- canary 1% traffic for 24h, run eval harness (N=50k prompts) + prod-shadow QA runs
- emit `cache_key_components` in debug logs for sample requests

jess_qa: I'll run the harness in prod-shadow mode against canary & baseline. add automatic guard: if prefix_repeat_rate > 0.2% rollback.

ops-bot: deploy request created: deploy/1749999988 -> staging -> canary(1%). Owner: devon. ETA: 30m. :robot_face:

devon: patch and unit tests ready. CI running. migration note: old cache entries will just expire; no migration needed.

rian: optional nicety: add a debug `x-cache-key-echo` header so customers can opt-in to see key differences during onboarding (helps debug regressions).

maria: good idea. I'll write a short runbook: mitigation (disable prefetch/speculative on route), dashboard links, and rollback steps.

jess_qa: will post canary numbers in ~6h.

devon: CI green, pushing to staging now.

maria: thanks all — closing once canary validates.
